impl.summary: Open-H3 Regenerate (n7-3) now finishes soft clips in three more places, on your GPU only, plus a 2K tier for MiniMax H3. (1) Faceless: an open-engine episode's menu has 'Regenerate to 1080p'. Its line reads 'Sharper, may redraw · Runs on your GPU · about N min · Free'. Each clip is redrawn at 1080p with the 576p preset and start sigma 0.8, from the scene's own words (its picture prompt plus its motion). Wan's 16 fps clips go through RIFE to 24 fps first. The clips are then joined the way the episode joins them, at 1080p, and the episode's own narration, bed and subtitles go back on. The download switches to the newer 1080p film. The cloud keeps SeedVR and shows no Regenerate. (2) Shorts: on an open-source short, each segment of up to 15 s has 'Enhance (H3 regenerate) · 1080p · Free'. It runs RIFE 16→24 fps, then Regenerate at 1080p (576p preset, sigma 0.8, the segment's restyle prompt), and the result is a new take to pick, marked HD. 'Stitch again' with an enhanced take brings the other takes to 24 fps and joins at 1080p, keeping each clip in its place. A cloud short says Enhance runs on your GPU. (3) Edit video: a result of up to 15 s has 'Enhance (H3 regenerate) · 1080p' in its menu. The server adds RIFE first whenever the stored clip's own header (tenant-safe) is under 24 fps, so Upscale → Video's Regenerate gets this too. (4) Cinema and the Video studio: MiniMax H3 models get a 2K tier. Cinema's Resolution chip shows 2K only for H3 models, with '768p draft, then redrawn at 2K on your GPU' on the open engine. On the cloud, fal's minimax-h3 at 2K is $0.13/s (already in its catalog). The open oss-minimax-h3 at 2K runs a 768p draft and then Open-H3 Regenerate at 2K. Text to video drafts on the new graph video-h3-t2v-2k, which saves its 768p latent as fuobe_h3_<draft id>_00001.safetensors. The finish runs on the new graph video-regenerate-h3-latent, which loads that file and upscales the latent directly, with no decode and re-encode. A take from a start frame is finished from its clip. Cinema takes get 'Finish in 2K' in their menu: Free on your GPU (from the saved latent when the draft kept one), or $0.13/s as a fal re-render. The 2K take lands in the same folder, within the project's cost limit. Engine mode 'Paid APIs only' hides every GPU-only control. Accounts get own-gpu-tool on the new studio routes, the same as those studios' other run routes.
built: Shared pure pieces in src/lib/catalog/regenerate.ts (n7-3's module, extended, not duplicated): REGEN_FINISH_SIGMA 0.8, REGEN_FINISH_TIER 1080p, REGEN_SMOOTH_MODEL oss-rife, needsSmoothing / sixteenFpsModel, finishLengthProblem (one pass ≤ 15 s), regenFinishSteps (optional RIFE → Regenerate as plan steps), canEnhance / enhanceRequest / ENHANCE_LABEL, H3_OPEN_MODEL, wantsH3TwoK, h3TwoKRequests, latentPrefixFor / latentFileFor, canFinishOpen and finishIn2k (fal re-render via n7-3's rerenderRequest, or a free redraw on your GPU).

Faceless: ENGINE_MODELS.open.regenerate (the cloud has none), regeneratePlan(graph, {engine, joinMax, lookup}) and regenerateReuses in src/lib/catalog/faceless.ts. EpisodePlan.regenerated {ids, final} and EpisodeView.regenerated / regenerating / regenerate. regenerateEpisode in src/server/faceless.ts uses createPipeline with existing ids for the clips, narration, words and bed. The new 'regenerate' action is on POST /api/faceless/episodes/[id]/[action]. A change or an undo clears the regenerated film, and stopping or deleting an episode cancels it. UI: a menu item in the episode's actions (menu width fixed at w-64), a status line in the header, and polling.

Shorts: ShortsTake.enhance {from, smooth}, ENHANCE_COPY, segmentSeconds, enhanceProblem, planEnhance and planFinishedStitch in src/lib/catalog/shorts.ts. planStitch takes opts.resolution, and a join group that mixes files and chained clips places each chained clip with ChainSlot.at so the order is kept. takeSteps knows enhanced takes. enhanceSegment is in src/server/shorts.ts (open shorts only, the chosen take finished, not already enhanced). The new route POST /api/shorts/sessions/[id]/segments/[index]/enhance uses the same once() nonce as Regenerate. UI: the segment card's button, the HD mark and accessible name on the take, the '(enhanced, 1080p)' line, and a one-line note on cloud shorts.

Edit video: the output action 'enhance-h3' (src/lib/output-actions.ts, result-actions.tsx) creates the run through POST /api/generations. createRegenerateRun (src/server/regenerate.ts) now reads fps from the stored file's header and runs oss-rife (targetFps 24) first for a clip under 24 fps; the passes chain from RIFE's clip, and both are canceled together on an error.

Cinema / Video studio: H3_2K_TIER, videoResolutionsFor(model) and H3_2K_OPEN_NOTE in src/lib/catalog/cinema.ts (VIDEO_RESOLUTIONS is unchanged). The prompt bar's Resolution chip uses the model's tiers and describes the 2K option. oss-minimax-h3 has resolutions ['768p', '2K']. createH3TwoKRun (src/server/regenerate.ts) is hooked into createGenerations: each take becomes draft + finish, and finished takes come first. finishTake is in src/server/cinema.ts, with the route POST /api/cinema/projects/[id]/items/[generationId]/finish. The tile menu's 'Finish in 2K' shows its price (Free, or ≈ $ at $0.13/s for the take's length).

Graphs (scripts/comfy, hand-built from rdh9616's 'Prompt to 2K' and 'Decode Saved Latent' examples at 9b686c5). video-h3-t2v-2k: FL2VA pruned int8 + LoraLoaderModelOnly minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.2_768p_comfyui_bf16 (lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo @ 3ec17a3, 1,956,193,000 B, sha256 c8168ebc…), MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo, BasicScheduler simple 6, er_sde, and OpenH3SaveRefinedLatent between the sampler and the decoder, with the soundtrack. video-regenerate-h3-latent: OpenH3LoadRefinedLatent → OpenH3RegenUpscale → RefineLatent → 3 Euler steps → save → fast VAE decode → Finish with the latent's frame count and sound. Also added: library.spec entries with licences (Turbo v1.2 Apache-2.0 per its card at 3ec17a3), BINDING_KEYS latentPrefix / latent, a KNOWN_MODELS pin and model-pins.json (size + SHA-256), the manifest entries, and requirements.json rebuilt (259,811 B after the last base merge). Variants in src/lib/comfy-variants.ts (H3_LATENT_DRAFT_GRAPH on extra.latentDraft, REGEN_LATENT_GRAPH on extra.latentFrom), so the GPU gate checks the graph that runs. The provider binds latentPrefix from the run's id and the latent file from latentFrom, refuses a finish with no words or no saved draft, and gives these graphs n7-3's missing-pack message. isH3Graph covers the draft graph, so it gets H3's canvas and 17n+5 frame grid. regenerateGraphLoras covers the latent graph.
GPU pre-flight: a 'MiniMax H3 in 2K' row (both graphs + the refiner LoRA). Rows with workflows now also list the LoRAs those graphs load themselves.

findings.title: Ad Multiplier on the open engine now asks MiniMax H3 for 2K: every new hook and CTA becomes a 768p draft plus an Open-H3 Regenerate pass
findings.where: src/lib/catalog/models.ts (oss-minimax-h3 resolutions ['768p','2K']) + src/server/marketing.ts:1111 nearestRes, used at :1045
findings.detail: nearestRes ranks tiers with parseInt, so parseInt('2K') is 2, which is below every wanted tier, and .pop() picks it. Ad Multiplier asks for 480p or 720p on the open engine (1080p is mapped to 720p), neither of which is in the list, so the hook and CTA clips now get resolution '2K'. On the base they got '768p'. createGenerations then routes them through createH3TwoKRun: a 768p draft (video-h3-t2v-2k for t2v), then oss-h3-regenerate at 1440p. That second pass needs the opt-in OPEN_H3_REGEN pack, the 12 GB refiner LoRA and about 48 GB of VRAM, and it is refused when the refiner LoRA is switched off. So hook and CTA runs that worked before now fail or cost GPU minutes, and the 2K clip is joined at 720p anyway. The same ModelDef change also puts '2K' into other places that list the model's tiers: Faceless's 'Quality' segmented control (settings-form.tsx:260 shows it once there are 2 tiers), Canvas and Assist. In Faceless, createPipeline keeps only made[0] in byKey, so the 768p drafts are never in plan.ids. Stop and Delete cancel the finish but leave the draft running. marketing-api.test.ts doesn't assert the resolution, so this isn't caught.
findings.evidence: Scratch probe (vitest, scratch config outside the worktree): planMultiplier({engine:'open', mode:'sections', hook, quality:'480p'|'720p'|'1080p'}) gives a hook step with oss-minimax-h3 params {duration:5, generateAudio:true, resolution:'2K'} for all three.
findings.fix: Offer 2K only where it is meant to be (Cinema / Video studio via videoResolutionsFor, keyed off the model), or rank tiers by height (cinema.ts tierHeight) in nearestRes and in any other picker. Add a regression test that Ad Multiplier's open hook stays at 768p. Either keep 2K out of the Faceless Quality control or track the draft ids in the plan.

findings.title: Saved-latent hand-off: the finish neither refuses plainly nor falls back to the clip, and Cinema's retry points the finish at the old draft
findings.where: src/lib/comfy-variants.ts REGEN_LATENT_GRAPH choice, src/server/providers/comfyui.ts:1414-1420, src/lib/catalog/regenerate.ts finishIn2k / h3TwoKRequests, src/server/cinema.ts retryItem
findings.detail: (a) The owner's workers (comfyWhere=workers): bin/lib/worker/checks.mjs cleanJob empties the worker's output/ after every job, so the draft's output/open_h3_latents file is gone before the finish runs, even on the same worker. vetGraph also refuses latent_file 'fuobe_h3_<id>_00001.safetensors' as model-unverified (the MODEL regex matches .safetensors). Every open 2K text-to-video run on workers therefore fails at the finish with 'The GPU that took this run refused it: it needs a model file that GPU couldn't verify.' (b) Any other mismatch: a different ComfyUI, comfyWhere changed before Cinema's later 'Finish in 2K', or a cleaned output folder. OpenH3LoadRefinedLatent.latent_file is a combo ([(newest)] + files on disk at 9b686c5), so ComfyUI's value_not_in_list goes through explainComfyError as 'ComfyUI can't find "fuobe_h3_…_00001.safetensors" (OpenH3LoadRefinedLatent.latent_file)'. That message is a raw file and node name, which is jargon if an account sees it (rule 5). Meanwhile the draft's own clip is chained into the same finish and could be redrawn instead. (c) Cinema retry: retryItem re-makes a failed draft under a new id, but the finish's stored request keeps extra.latentFrom = the failed draft's id. The retried finish then looks for a latent that was never written, or finishes the failed attempt's latent if it got past the save node.
findings.evidence: Pack source at 9b686c5 (scratchpad clone): Save writes output/open_h3_latents/<basename(prefix)>_{index:05d}.safetensors with index = 1 + the highest existing, and Load's latent_file is a COMBO. Worker code: checks.mjs cleanJob/vetGraph, relay.ts tabFailureWords. Probe: in a Cinema project, a failed 2K t2v draft YzI69Z6KF4QZ is retried as ys7E6oSD3eGT, while the new finish has extra.latentFrom = YzI69Z6KF4QZ.
findings.fix: Choose the latent graph only when the draft ran on the ComfyUI the finish will use (not on workers), else finish from the chained clip (REGEN_WORKFLOW). Take latentFrom from the dependency at launch, not from an id baked in at creation. Give a missing latent plain words, or fall back.

findings.title: latentFrom is client-controlled and unchecked: an account's run can name another run's saved latent
findings.detail: POST /api/generations passes params.extra through. A request for oss-h3-regenerate with extra.latentFrom = X switches to video-regenerate-h3-latent and binds fuobe_h3_X_00001.safetensors. Nothing checks that X is the asker's own run or a latentDraft run. tenant.ts and account-inputs.ts only see inputs.video, which can be the attacker's own clip. On an account's own GPU this is harmless. With hosted runs (FUOBE_HOSTED_RUNS=1), the account's run goes to the install's own ComfyUI, which also holds the owner's draft latents and other accounts' pooled ones. The run would then render someone else's private draft in 2K for the attacker (it needs the run id). The brief's rule says a new server path that reads a file for a run goes through tenant/account-inputs, with a test.
findings.evidence: Probe: inside runAsTenant({kind:'account', id:'acct-x'}), prepareWorkflow('video-regenerate-h3', {video: <acct-x's own clip>, extra:{latentFrom:'OWNERSdraft01', draftFrom:'h3'}}) gave node 1 OpenH3LoadRefinedLatent with latent_file 'fuobe_h3_OWNERSdraft01_00001.safetensors'. No refusal.
findings.fix: Treat latentDraft/latentFrom as server-only (strip them from client requests the way STAMP_FIELDS are stripped), or check generationAccount(latentFrom) === tenantAccount() and that the run kept a latent. Add a tests/account-*.test.ts case.

findings.title: The new LightX2V FL2V Turbo 4-step v1.2 LoRA isn't in Settings → Models & licences and has no switch
findings.where: src/server/model-access.ts loraRows (CHARACTER_LORAS and REGEN_LORA are listed, the 4-step isn't); scripts/comfy/library.spec.mjs
findings.detail: The LoRA's licence is recorded only inside the manifest licence string of the variant graph video-h3-t2v-2k. No route endpoint names that graph, so modelLicence(oss-minimax-h3) never shows it, and accessList has no LoRA row for it. That breaks the owner's rule: every LoRA's licence is shown as data where the admin turns it on or off. The 8-step Turbo (CHARACTER_LORAS) and the refiner LoRA (REGEN_LORA) each have a row. The draft run also doesn't check a switch for it, and it isn't downloaded the way regenerateGraphLoras downloads the refiner.
findings.evidence: Probe: JSON.stringify(accessList()) includes '8step_v1.0': true, 'open_h3_regenerate_2k_lora': true, '4step_v1.2': false. modelLicence(oss-minimax-h3) doesn't mention v1.2.
findings.fix: Add a row (Apache-2.0 per its card at 3ec17a3, 'the current card no longer states a licence'), like the 8-step entry, and honour its switch for the 2K draft.

findings.title: A 2K H3 run whose words come from an earlier step finishes from the literal '{text}'
findings.detail: The finish copies original.prompt but only chains the video slot. For a Canvas or Assist text → video step at 2K (prompt '{text}', chain [{slot:'prompt'}]), the draft gets the real words, but the finish is created with prompt '{text}' and chain [{slot:'video'}]. Regenerate then redraws at 2K from the placeholder.
findings.evidence: Probe: createGenerations({modelId:'oss-minimax-h3', op:'t2v', prompt:'{text}', chain:[{slot:'prompt'}], params:{resolution:'2K'}}, {dependsOn: <write step>}) gives oss-h3-regenerate with prompt '{text}' and chain [{slot:'video'}].
findings.fix: Also chain the text step into the finish (a prompt slot from the same dependency), or refuse 2K when the words are chained.

findings.title: Previews and hosted runs plan and price a 2K H3 run as only the H3 jobs
findings.where: src/server/generations.ts previewGeneration vs createGenerations (createH3TwoKRun); src/server/hosted-run.ts decidePlace/poolQuote
findings.detail: ?preview=1 (and the pool's plan and billing quote) shows N oss-minimax-h3 jobs and says nothing about the N Open-H3 Regenerate passes that createGenerations then adds. With hosted runs on, poolAllows only checks oss-minimax-h3. The finish then runs oss-h3-regenerate (48 GB, ~3 min per 5 s) on the install's GPUs under the same stamp and hold, even if the policy denies that model. The implementer flagged this as untested.
findings.evidence: Probe: previewGeneration(oss-minimax-h3, t2v, 2K, numOutputs 2) gives jobs 2, outputs 2, no notes. createGenerations makes 4 rows (2 × oss-h3-regenerate 1440p + 2 × oss-minimax-h3 768p latentDraft).
findings.fix: Plan and price the finish in previewGeneration for wantsH3TwoK, check poolAllows for REGEN_MODEL too, and add a test in the style of tests/hosted-runs.test.ts.

findings.title: Finish in 2K can be repeated without limit, including on a 2K run's own draft
findings.detail: No once() nonce (Shorts' Enhance has one) and no check for a 2K finish the take already has. Each click on a fal take is another paid 2K render (the cap check still applies). The 768p draft of a 2K run also offers 'Finish in 2K' even though its finished take already exists.
findings.fix: Take a requestId nonce like Shorts' Enhance, and hide or refuse the action when the take already has a 2K finish.

findings.title: Edit video's menu item doesn't say it runs on your GPU
findings.detail: 'Enhance (H3 regenerate) · 1080p' also shows on cloud Edit video results when the Engine mode is Both, but only the toast mentions the GPU. The owner's rule asks the UI to say plainly what each engine does. Shorts' button title and the Faceless line do say it.
findings.fix: Add 'on your GPU' to the label or a hint, as in Shorts and Faceless.

findings.title: Hot-file edit to tests/comfy-library-4.test.ts (rule 2)
findings.detail: It adds two lines to the exact unvalidated list. The edit can't be avoided because the test pins the whole list with toEqual, and both graphs must stay validated:false. It is the same exception as n7-3, whose 'video-regenerate-h3' line is already on origin/main (65dd7f9d, line 158). The PR note says to take main's version on a conflict and re-add the two lines. That is acceptable if the PR says so.

checks: Turbo LoRA pin at source (HF API tree @ 3ec17a324ced54151364f24f8b5fb6bf7e26414f): minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.2_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors is 1,956,193,000 B, lfs sha256 c8168ebc17bbacc4296103dda2fec1ba85b24392fa08cf2bfbcef0cff0dc3cc8. This matches model-pins.json and the manifest URL.

rdh pack source at 9b686c5 (raw __init__.py): Save writes <basename(prefix)>_{index:05d}.safetensors under output/open_h3_latents, so a fresh prefix gives _00001 and latentFileFor matches. Load's latent_file is a COMBO ([(newest)] + files on disk). frame_count 0 means all frames in Finish. Finding 2 (medium): the hand-off is decided when each run starts, on the ComfyUI it goes to. comfyPlace() (providers/comfyui.ts) names it: an account's link or computer, the owner's computer, or this install's server; null on the owner's workers, which empty output/ after every job. The draft keeps its latent only where a place exists and its LoRA is on, and records meta.latentAt. advanceDependents sets the finish's latentFrom from the draft it waits for (latentFromDependency), never from an id baked in at creation, so a Cinema retry loads the new draft's latent. createH3TwoKRun no longer stores latentFrom. submitNow's latentHandOff keeps latentFrom only for a succeeded latent-keeping run of the same account on the same place that no earlier finish found gone; otherwise the finish redraws its chained clip (REGEN_WORKFLOW). When ComfyUI's /prompt refuses the Load Refined Latent node (file gone), the provider submits the clip graph in the same run. On someone's computer (where the tab reports the refusal later), promptRefusal gives REGEN_COPY.latentGone in plain words, and the next finish or a Retry redraws the clip. The tests are tests/regenerate-latent.test.ts against a fake ComfyUI (the draft saves under its id with latentAt; the finish loads that file; fallback in one run; Cinema retry loads the new draft; places; the workers / other ComfyUI / another's run / LoRA-off cases; the plain words).

A client's latentFrom/latentDraft is dropped and the clip graph is sent. Inside the server, a finish naming the owner's or another account's draft on the same ComfyUI redraws the clip, while its own draft's latent loads. fix.finalSummary: Open engine (your ComfyUI). These pieces are built and checked against fake ComfyUIs and in the browser, but not run on a GPU. Faceless 'Regenerate to 1080p', Shorts 'Enhance (H3 regenerate)', Edit video's 'Enhance (H3 regenerate) · 1080p · on your GPU' with RIFE first under 24 fps, and MiniMax H3's 2K tier in the Video studio and Cinema. The 2K tier is a 768p draft plus an Open-H3 Regenerate finish, and is now offered only there: Ad Multiplier, UGC, Faceless, Canvas and Assist stay at 768p. The draft keeps its latent only on a ComfyUI that keeps files (not the owner's workers) and while the Turbo 4-step LoRA is on. The finish loads it only from the same account's draft on the same ComfyUI, named from the draft it waits for when it starts, and otherwise redraws the draft's clip. Cinema's 'Finish in 2K' happens once per take, with a request id. It is Free on your GPU, from the saved latent when that latent is usable. Cloud engine: fal's minimax-h3 at 2K ($0.13/s) for Cinema and Video studio H3 takes, and Finish in 2K re-renders on the same hosted model. Faceless keeps SeedVR. Regenerate, Enhance and the 2K finish are GPU-only and hidden in 'Paid APIs only'. These need a fal key, and no fal call was made here. Public sign-up. Guests get 401 on the three new routes. Accounts get 403 own-gpu-tool on the Faceless, Shorts and Cinema routes, as before. Through POST /api/generations an account runs the 2K tier on its own GPU, or on the install's GPUs with hosted runs, where the finish is planned, priced and policy-checked. A client can never name or keep a latent, and an account never loads the owner's or another account's latent.
